Who We Are

Driving Somalia's Digital Future
Through Innovation & Excellence

HANKAABE ICT Solutions is a leading technology and digital transformation company dedicated to empowering governments, financial institutions, businesses, NGOs, and educational organizations with innovative, secure, and scalable ICT solutions.

Founded on a vision to accelerate digital growth across Somalia and the Horn of Africa, we specialize in software development, digital infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud solutions, systems integration, and IT consultancy. Our commitment is to transform ideas into powerful digital solutions that enhance efficiency, transparency, and sustainable growth.

With a highly skilled team of technology professionals and a passion for excellence, we deliver world-class solutions tailored to the unique needs of our clients. Every project we undertake is driven by innovation, reliability, and a commitment to creating lasting impact.

At HANKAABE ICT Solutions, we don't just build technology — we build the future.

Innovation. Integrity. Excellence. Transformation.

Our Mission

Empower East Africa Through Technology

To deliver world-class ICT solutions that enable Somali businesses, government ministries, NGOs, and educational institutions to operate securely, efficiently, and competitively in the global digital economy.

Our Vision

The Leading ICT Force in the Horn of Africa
